system:
Two claims about the same repository contradict each other. Determine which is true.

You are working in the repository these claims are about. Read it before you answer — check whether
the configuration actually changed, and when. Do not adjudicate from the two claims alone when the
files and the history are there to settle it.

Possible outcomes:

new_wins        The new claim is correct; the existing one is stale. Something changed.
existing_wins   The existing claim still holds; the new one is mistaken or describes a special case.
both_scoped     Both are true under narrower scopes. Return the corrected scope for each.
                This is common — different environments, access paths, or time periods.
undecidable     The evidence does not settle it.

undecidable is a legitimate answer, not a failure. A human will decide. Choosing it costs a review;
guessing wrong silently corrupts the knowledge base. Prefer undecidable when genuinely uncertain.

Cite what you checked. If you read a file or a commit, say which and what it showed.

Do not modify anything. Answering this is a read; whatever else you can do here, this is not the
place to do it.

value.reasoning: Auto-publish was deliberately removed. src/io/commit/publish.ts's header comment says push+PR "used to be the tail of every run's commit, which meant a successful run ended with a PR ... nobody had asked for (19-value-to-a-user.md, open item 1). The run now stops at a local commit (./commit-port.ts) and this is the step the developer says yes to." Publishing is now its own CLI command (src/cli/commands/publish.ts); src/cli/commands/run.ts imports only countUnpublished from publish.ts and its comment at line 351 says "pushing and the pull request are `signpost publish`'s, and so is that code." src/cli/commands/review.ts:97 prints "Committed to <branch>, not pushed. Run `signpost publish`...". README.md:96-98 and 125-128 state a run commits locally and "The push and the pull request are a separate step, `signpost publish`ā€¦ it runs only when you say yes." The existing claim describes the superseded behaviour.
evidenceChecked: src/io/commit/publish.ts (lines 1-100) — header documents the removal of auto-publish; publishBranch is only reachable via makePublish
src/cli/commands/run.ts:25,302,351 — run only counts unpublished commits; comment assigns push/PR to publish
src/cli/commands/review.ts:91,97 — 'Committed to <branch>, not pushed. Run `signpost publish`'
README.md:93-98, 122-128, 172-174 — run stops at a local commit; publish is a separate, opt-in step
